rationale.text: A search field with no visible label has an adjacent button that reads Rechercher and an aria-label. The test accepts an adjacent button giving the field a visible label while aria-label gives it an accessible name. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 3: a mechanism is present); only judgment can confirm the adjacent-button condition. The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.

citations.quote: Un bouton adjacent au champ de formulaire lui fournit une étiquette visible et un élément `<label>` visuellement caché ou un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` ou `title` lui fournit un nom accessible.
Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label`
